claims.statement: Stored parameter capacity and the subset of expert weights used per token are different quantities; sparse selection does not delete unselected experts, and local FFN counts exclude shared attention/embedding/other modules.
claims.scope: General sparse MoE distinction plus this section's explicit local FFN boundary. Opening 100M/20M figures are an illustrative statement, not a claim about a measured repository model. Total storage may be distributed/offloaded; no assertion that all weights must be resident on one GPU.

All experts are retained in ModuleList and the router selects a per-token subset; selection does not remove parameter objects.
Confirms embedding, attention and normalization shared modules remain outside expert FFNs.
